content.text: Accum of fluid in pericardial space
▪︎5-15mL of fluid in pericardial space normally
: viral · idiopathic · immune · malig (lung CA MC · breast second MC) · aortic dissection · uremia
Pericardial effusion → sig P on ♡ → ⍉♡ filling → ↓CO & shock
▪︎effusion can be comp of RHF - USU transudative ← ↑R-sided filling P
: comp of acute pericarditis or trauma - malig MC ⍉traumatic cause
▪︎⍉traumatic: malig · acute or chronic pericarditis · bact pericarditis · uremia · spont hemorrhage · SLE · post-radiation · myxedema
▪︎restricts diastol filling 1st → systol funct later - onset depends on rate of fluid accum
▪︎classic but ⍉always present - ↑JVP also R HF & cor pulmonale (↑RA P)
▪︎tachy · pallor · cold sweats · LV failure · HF Sx
▪︎effusion EKG: often norm or sinus tachy w low QRS voltage (<5mm limb leads · <10mm precordial)
▪︎electrical alternans (tamponade): alternating high & low QRS amplitudes ← ♡ swings in fluid-filled pericardium → axis Δ each beat
▪︎enlrg ♡ silhouette - may be norm (depends on rate of accum)
▪︎diastol collapse of RV: less sens but very specific
▪︎early systol collapse of RA: sens & specific
▪︎initial: IVF bolus 500-1,000mL - temporizing only - pericardiocentesis = definitive
